name: Shifting Wind
text: Before bidding, convert all your hearts to diamonds, or all your diamonds to hearts.
archetypes: Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus, Discard Dominance
decision: Which way to convert: build one long red suit for Diamond Flood or Heart Chorus, or empty one to open a void.
opponent: Everyone bids after the swap and sees the new suits through play; no loss of agency.
aiNote: Convert the shorter of the two suits into the longer one.
rationale: Merging the two red suits builds one long suit for a flood or chorus and often opens a void in the other, with one easy choice.
deviation: Simplified from choosing any two non-spade suits to swap, which was hard to read.
